title: Scenario B: Conflicting Picture in Grid Sector 7 (Primary Demo)
description: Multi-source reconnaissance reports contradictory movement signatures during an active forward reconnaissance patrol.
learning_objectives: Identify and cross-reference divergent intelligence feeds under temporal delay
Resolve information asymmetry between Team Lead and Specialist roles before committing assets

payload.summary: Eagle-1 visual confirms 6 vehicles on Axis Bravo moving toward Sector 7 bridgehead.
Sentinel Radar returns indicate intermittent RCS inconsistent with heavy armor.

payload.observation: Axis Bravo convoy is unmanned tractor decoys. Actual hostile force concealed on Ridge Charlie!

decision_points.prompt: Eagle-1 insists mechanized convoy is advancing. Specialist reports decoy Doppler and OP Echo warns of ambush. Issue order:

options.label: Commit Quick Reaction Force to Axis Bravo
options.description: Intercept the visible convoy on Axis Bravo immediately.

options.label: Hold Bridgehead & Request Cross-Verification
options.description: Maintain defensive posture and authenticate Doppler anomaly.

options.label: Preemptive Recon Flank to Ridge Charlie
options.description: Probe Ridge Charlie while screening Axis Bravo.

outcome_rules.title: BRIDGEHEAD HELD
outcome_rules.message: Cross-verification confirms the Axis Bravo convoy is unmanned. The force on Ridge Charlie moves early and is exposed. The bridgehead is intact and no losses are reported.

outcome_rules.title: RECON ELEMENT COMPROMISED
outcome_rules.message: The recon team reaches Ridge Charlie and makes contact. Heavy fire forces it to withdraw with casualties. The bridgehead stays secure, but the enemy now knows it was found.

outcome_rules.title: QRF LOST ON AXIS BRAVO
outcome_rules.message: The QRF engages the convoy and finds only unmanned tractors. The force on Ridge Charlie then strikes the undefended bridgehead from the flank.

outcome_rules.title: NO ORDER ISSUED
outcome_rules.message: No orders were given in time. The force on Ridge Charlie advances and the bridgehead is caught unprepared.

OPT_HOLD_VERIFY.feedback: Held the bridgehead and sought cross-verification before committing assets. This is the sound response to conflicting feeds.

OPT_FLANK_CHARLIE.feedback: Avoided the decoy, but acted on a single unverified HUMINT report and risked exposing the recon element.

OPT_IMMEDIATE_STRIKE.feedback: Committed the QRF against a decoy convoy on one feed while contradicting reports existed, leaving the bridgehead exposed to the real force on Ridge Charlie.

instructor_injects.label: OP Echo: engine noise on Ridge Charlie

payload.observation: Engine noise on Ridge Charlie is increasing. Heavy vehicles are moving into position.
